stories.title: Peppermint Secures $4.7 Million to Fix Clinical Trial Billing
stories.simple_summary: A company called Peppermint raised money to build AI software that helps hospitals handle billing for medical research studies.
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to hospitals and investors — nothing you need to act on personally.

stories.title: From Its First Ecommerce Site to AI Adoption, Gap Looks Back While Looking Forward
stories.simple_summary: Gap, the clothing store, is sharing its history of moving to online shopping and is now using AI to help run their business.
stories.why_it_matters: If you shop at Gap online or in stores, their AI might help them stock better inventory or improve your experience, but nothing major changes for you.

stories.title: ‘Dystopian’: Co-op becomes latest firm to put staff under AI surveillance
stories.simple_summary: A large grocery store called Co-op started using AI to watch what their employees are doing during work.
stories.why_it_matters: If you work in retail or customer service, this shows a trend of employers using AI cameras to monitor workers — something worth being aware of when looking for jobs.

stories.title: Fired OpenAI employees raise concerns over AI safety, monitoring
stories.simple_summary: Some employees who left OpenAI (the company that makes ChatGPT) are speaking up about safety concerns with their AI systems.
stories.why_it_matters: This matters mainly to people investing in or working for AI companies — regular folks don't need to do anything.

stories.title: Most Americans think artificial intelligence is developing too fast, a new AP-NORC poll finds
stories.simple_summary: A poll shows most Americans believe AI is being developed too quickly without enough thought about safety.
stories.why_it_matters: This reflects widespread concern that many people share, but it doesn't change anything in your daily life right now.

stories.title: Are Artificial Intelligence Chatbots Safe? | IFLScience The Big Questions
stories.simple_summary: A science website is discussing whether chatbots like ChatGPT are safe to use.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use AI chatbots, it's good to know people are asking safety questions, but this is mostly background discussion rather than breaking news.

stories.title: Manus raises more than $500 million after Meta exit
stories.simple_summary: A company called Manus raised a lot of money after being spun off from Meta (Facebook's parent company).
stories.why_it_matters: This mostly matters to investors — nothing you need to act on.

stories.title: Jeff Bezos reveals AI vision that could transform the American workweek
stories.simple_summary: Jeff Bezos (who founded Amazon) shared ideas about how AI could change how much people work in America.
stories.why_it_matters: This is speculation about the distant future — nothing concrete to act on now, but worth paying attention to if you're thinking about jobs long-term.

stories.title: Nous Research confirms it hit $1.5B valuation, launches AI agents for business users
stories.simple_summary: A company called Nous Research raised money and released AI 'agents' — software that can handle business tasks like a helper would.
stories.why_it_matters: If you run a business, AI agents that can do specific tasks might become useful tools in the future, but they're still new.

stories.title: Microsoft releases new Nvidia-chip AI PCs with revamped Windows 11
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft released new laptops that are specially designed to run AI programs and come with updated Windows 11 software. They start at $2,599.
stories.why_it_matters: If you need a very powerful laptop for special AI work, this is an option — but for most people, regular laptops still work fine.

stories.title: ChatGPT’s ‘Intelligent UI’ update fills its responses with pictures, charts, and buttons
stories.simple_summary: ChatGPT now shows pictures, charts, and clickable buttons in its answers instead of just text.
stories.why_it_matters: If you use ChatGPT, answers will be easier to understand with visuals — a nice improvement for anyone asking it questions.

stories.title: Everything announced at Microsoft’s Surface Laptop Ultra event
stories.simple_summary: Microsoft announced details about its new Surface Laptop Ultra laptop and other Windows products at a big event.
stories.why_it_matters: If you're shopping for an expensive high-powered laptop, this is worth checking out — but it's a premium product mainly for people who need lots of computing power.
